mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_favorite (user_id, stock_id, sort_order, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{stockId}, #{sortOrder}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_id = #{stockId}
mapper.select: SELECT uf.id, uf.user_id, uf.stock_id, uf.sort_order, uf.remark, uf.created_at, si.stock_code AS stockCode, si.stock_name AS stockName, si.exchange, si.current_price AS currentPrice, si.change_percent AS changePercent, 0 AS volume FROM user_favorite uf LEFT JOIN stock_info si ON uf.stock_id = si.id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.sort_order ASC
